g.text: FB_SLITS: gap and center requests and the four blade moves.
FB_SLITS_THERMAL adds the blade RTDs, the flow switch and the
PMPS database. FB_SLITS_POWER adds the PMPS aperture bridge and
A PRG picks the variant: FB_SLITS in txi-sxr and txi-hxr,
FB_SLITS_POWER for SL1K0 and SL2K0 in kfe.
Unlike the other devices there is no core: the slit is one
chain and does not own a state mover.
